notes.title: Something Wicked Lies Beneath Weekly Development Update #1
notes.content:
[h1][b]Fluff[/b][/h1]

Last week, the steam store page for my game, Something Wicked Lies Beneath went live ( go wishlist now btw ). The game is still in a comical amount of early development, and I want to start giving updates on how development is going!

This past week has been relatively uneventful, as I've been overwhelmed by excitement after getting the steam page up and running for the first time.



[h1][b]Update[/b][/h1]

The only eventful thing I've done so far is begin creation on the Starting Room ( the room you start in )
Here you can see The Objective Terminal, where youll be bringing the battery to in order to get your objective list. Ive took inspiration and modelled directly after old vintage technology like keyboards, data storage and the screens and little random details.

[imaged, various machinery and technology]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44104952/f80b2a609ee67c883cf29fa7ec4af90d9e4c0253.png[/img]

[imaged, the battery being inserted into The Objective Terminal to power it]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44104952/ba600aa0474b282e7e7cbd844e7d5d56af5186ae.png[/img]

Ive also gotten a basic layout of the Starting Room done aswell. Here you can see the main room where you will spawn and also acquire/complete objectives. Off to the side is a inaccessible security room, just for immersive flavor. The hallway leading up to the backside will be an airlock of sorts, and to further immersion, there is a closet on the otherside aswell.

[imaged, the general WIP layout of the starting room]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44104952/db65666fb3b085ff575c66fcfccf9032e68e82d5.png[/img]



[h1][b]Plans for next week[/b][/h1]

Next week I plan on completing the starting room and begin working on a more proper gameplay trailer. You may also see many small or large changes to the steam page itself.



[h1][b]SUPPORT[/b][/h1]

If you enjoy what you see and what to support the game, please go wishlist the game. If you want to support me further, follow my [url=https://twitter.com/AveGameDev]Twitter[/url] and my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TheVenusianSun/featured]Youtube Channel[/url]. You can also spread the word about the game! Wishlists will REALLY help me out within the Steam Algorithm. If you want to support me financially, someday I may set up a patreon aswell!


You can also check out the youtube video version of this announcement [url=https://youtu.be/JpdI2oXUvyM]here[/url]
